purpose: Copies rendered HTML and plain text to the Windows clipboard in both CF_HTML and CF_UNICODETEXT formats.
calls_out_to: OpenClipboard / EmptyClipboard / SetClipboardData / CloseClipboard — Win32 clipboard API
RegisterClipboardFormatW(L"HTML Format") — registers the CF_HTML format
GlobalAlloc / GlobalLock / GlobalUnlock / GlobalFree — HGLOBAL memory management
invariants: Always calls CloseClipboard even if individual SetClipboardData calls fail
Returns true if at least one of HTML or plain-text was placed on the clipboard
gotchas: CF_HTML format requires a specific byte-offset header (Version/StartHTML/EndHTML/StartFragment/EndFragment); BuildCfHtml constructs this with snprintf byte counting
Header size is computed with a probe snprintf(nullptr, 0, ...) call to get the exact length before allocating — offset arithmetic depends on this being exact
